kind: the new coordinated frames of Experiment 101, frozen from the tokenizer and the text rules alone; no model output

rules.candidates_025: the adjective is not a word of 025's ordered candidate lists (the adjective reserve, the new list and both forms of the ordinary reserve), by word or by single-token id
rules.deviation: a selection that differs from the expected picks writes nothing and stops for review
rules.distinct: no two 101 frames share the adjective
rules.earlier_cues: the adjective's id is not in 024's committed exclusion (the cue ids of 005–023), not one of 024's or 025's cues
rules.not_applied: 025's frame_tokens set (a token of an exposed frame) is not applied: novelty is at the level of the text (design §11)
rules.number_words: the adjective is not a number word
rules.selection: the first n_frames eligible candidates in the listed order, by the tokenizer alone; no other choice, and no frame is replaced after the freeze
rules.structure: pm._build_new_frame accepts the text with the reference and the primary cue, and again with each stratum cue sharing the same prefix and suffix; the cue is a single token at p_c within the range; the adjective is one token at p_t = p_c + 1
rules.target_forms: the adjective's id is not a form of a pool target noun (rr.target_noun_form_ids) nor of 020's confirmation nouns (cr.prior_nouns)
rules.text: the text template is none of the frame texts of b0c.exclusion (020's pool, the 006–020 confirmations, the 005 extension and 022's frames), as 023's committed exclusion records them, and none of 023's own frame templates; 024 and 025 added no frames
